# Test Assertion Updater Agent

> **Agent Type**: Test Automation & Maintenance
> **Version**: 1.0.0
> **Status**: 🟢 ACTIVE
> **Priority**: HIGH

---

## 🎯 Purpose

Automatically detect and fix test assertion mismatches when implementation evolves while preserving test intent and coverage.

## 📋 Capabilities

- Parse pytest failure output to identify assertion errors
- Extract expected vs actual values from failure messages
- Analyze implementation code to understand current behavior
- Generate corrected assertions that align with implementation
- Validate fixes using property-based testing (Hypothesis)
- Auto-commit fixes with detailed explanations

## 🔧 Usage

### GitHub Actions Trigger

```yaml
name: Test Assertion Updater
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI Tests"]
    types: [completed]
    
jobs:
  update-assertions:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Test Assertion Updater
        uses: ./.github/agents/test-assertion-updater
        with:
          pytest-output: ${{ steps.tests.outputs.log }}
          auto-commit: true
          validate-with-hypothesis: true
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Analyze test failure and suggest fixes
python -m agents.test_assertion_updater analyze tests/test_example.py::test_function

# Auto-fix with validation
python -m agents.test_assertion_updater fix tests/test_example.py::test_function --validate

# Dry-run mode
python -m agents.test_assertion_updater fix tests/test_example.py --dry-run
```
